description: This file defines the RedisClusteringOptions class, which encapsulates configuration options for Redis clustering in Orleans, including methods for creating Redis connections and keys, as well as a validator class for configuration validation.

classes.name: RedisClusteringOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration settings for Redis clustering, including connection options, key creation delegate, and entry expiry.

classes.name: RedactRedisConfigurationOptions
classes.description: Custom attribute class for redacting Redis configuration details, especially passwords.

classes.name: RedisClusteringOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the RedisClusteringOptions configuration, ensuring required properties are set.

methods.name: DefaultCreateMultiplexer
methods.description: Creates a default Redis connection multiplexer asynchronously using the provided configuration options.

methods.name: DefaultCreateRedisKey
methods.description: Generates a Redis key based on cluster options, encoding the service and cluster IDs.

methods.name: Redact
methods.description: Redacts sensitive information from ConfigurationOptions, such as passwords.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the ConfigurationOptions property is set; throws exception if not.
